profile.description:
イラストレーター/ドールディーラー ( #ユメミっ子 )
ご依頼はXのDM、ココナラ、skebにてお仕事募集中。
WEBTOON『殿下、甘えていいから闇堕ちしないで？(完結)』の30話より仕上げ担当。『Zアイランド(完結済)』の仕上げを担当しています。

Hello, I came across your profile and thought your art style was very unique! I especially love the style you used here: https://skeb.jp/@krmcelma/works/14

It would be great if you could draw my FFXIV character on the Crescent Moon mount and having a chat with the Loporrit on the mount! They can both be smiling or grinning! I have linked the reference pictures! 

Thank you for your consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/sxDfbj3

I have attached an alternative style to my character as well if you find that more suitable!

She is a FFXIV Original Character who is a vigilante. Her common motifs (optional) are silver chains and straps.

Please feel free to decide on the composition and style :) Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rbMRu2xuCeb5WN5Xh6oJJXxVgmj27Ae6?usp=sharing

I will leave the pose and the facial expression up to you, and I would like the aspect ratio at 16:9. My vtuber's personality is elegant, peaceful and happy. It would be awesome if the background is colourful, maybe like that in a galaxy with glistening stars around. 

I will be mainly using the illustration for Twitter/X banner, and twitch or youtube thumbnails, if you are agreeable. It would be awesome if you could divide the layers of the background and the character.

- She appears as someone elegant and refined.
- She's also very motherly and loves children.
- Her main motifs are spiders, spider lilies, and butterflies
